title: Gap
description: The gap between the facit (stories=truth) and the implementation map (how it's built today). Derived = facit vs implementation. This is the build backlog: each item names the AC it serves and what must change. Keyed by AC id.

facitVersion.description: facitHash the gap was computed against.

gapType.description: sound = implementation satisfies the AC; contradicted = code does the opposite of the AC.

whatsMissing.description: What the implementation lacks vs the AC.

action.description: What to build/change (willing to rewrite) to close it.
